messages.subject: Pvalue canculation
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

In my project, I have 6 bacterial strains in single replicate and I want to compare three of them (from one lineage) to others (3 strains from another lineage). In the matrix, I had specified (1/3,1/3,1/3,-1/3,-1/3,-1/3) and MSstats generated pvalues for me as well (version 3.9.0). Now I tried the same thing with the same version but it didn't generate pvalues. I am wondering if the pvalue calculation depends on another R package. I am not sure if I have updated other packages but definitely I have the MSstats version. Could you please help me with this.

Best,
Amir

messages.subject: Re: Pvalue canculation
messages.body_plain: You need to have replicates in order to calculate the standard error of the estimate, the t-statistic, and the p-value. This is true for MSstats and statistical inference in general.

or use the Skyline installer again (as you did before).
